user.description: Configura FBM en modo invitado. La conexión con la API oficial todavía está pendiente de validación.

abort.already_configured: La integración FBM ya está configurada.

confirm.title: Follow entire competition
confirm.description: Team: {team}. Official group: {group}. Confirm to download standings, fixtures and every team roster.

manage.title: Unfollow a competition
manage.description: The competition will no longer be followed. Historic snapshots remain.

unfollow.title: Confirm unfollow
unfollow.description: Unfollow group {group}? Historic snapshots will be preserved.

refresh.title: Choose competition to refresh
refresh.description: Only previously followed groups with a verified source team are shown.

refresh_confirm.title: Confirm competition refresh
refresh_confirm.description: Group: {group}. Manually refresh standings and fixtures. Roster downloads are optional and off by default.

data.incluir_plantillas: Also download available rosters and statistics

automatic.title: Automatically refresh competitions
automatic.description: Only explicitly followed competitions. Standings and fixtures every 4 hours (one group per tick); individual statistics in batches of five every 2 hours, with a 24-hour pause after a complete cycle. No new roster downloads. Both choices are off by default.

data.auto_players: Also refresh already archived players' statistics

error.season_unverified: Season not yet verified; no data saved
error.competition_changed: Season, phase or group changed. Select the new competition in search.
error.rosters_pending: Standings, fixtures and available rosters were saved. Some rosters are pending. Confirm again to retry.
error.rosters_pending_named: Standings, fixtures and available rosters were saved. Pending rosters: {pending_rosters}. Confirm again to retry.
error.auto_requires_groups: Enable group updates before enabling player statistics.

abort.no_refreshable_groups: No followed competitions have a verified reference team; select them again
